Purity and Formulations.q: How can you tell if a substance is pure?
Purity and Formulations.a: It has a sharp specific melting point
d: It has a high boiling point

Purity and Formulations.q: What does an impurity do to the melting point?
Purity and Formulations.a: It lowers and broadens the melting range
A mixture designed with precise proportions for a specific purpose

Chromatography.q: What is the Rf value formula?
Chromatography.a: Distance moved by substance divided by distance moved by solvent front
d: Distance moved by solvent divided by distance moved by substance
Distance moved by substance multiplied by solvent distance
Total distance divided by number of spots

Chromatography.q: What does a single spot on a chromatogram indicate?
Chromatography.a: The sample contains only one component (or all components have the same Rf)

Chromatography.q: What is the mobile phase in paper chromatography?
Chromatography.a: The solvent that moves through the paper
